scope: Public personal website, charts, transformed aggregate JSON and CSV/ZIP; no raw institutional documents or logos. Operational publication review, not a legal opinion.

Eurostat.evidence: Statistical data reuse permitted with acknowledgement, subject to individual notices. This release uses tourism statistical cells, not maps, logos or third-party illustrations.
Eurostat.attribution: Source: Eurostat. Data selected, normalized and used in calculations by Konstantinos Fotoglou; the European Union and Eurostat are not responsible for these modifications.

Bank of Greece.evidence: Accurate attributed reproduction is allowed, but modification requires prior written consent. Clearance for transformed downloadable tables and derived charts has not been established. Entire family conservatively withheld, not declared universally prohibited.
Bank of Greece.attribution: Consult Bank of Greece Travel Services for receipts, travellers, visits and nights.

Fraport Greece.evidence: Website terms restrict use on other websites without written consent. No applicable permission is held for this release; traffic values, charts and downloads withheld.
Fraport Greece.attribution: Consult Fraport Greece's official traffic reports.

GISCO.evidence: Specific geometry redistribution conditions were not resolved in this publication review. Withhold geometry and map, retain accommodation rankings without boundaries.
